desc: Formalize walk-expansion proof and exponent-sum lemma (Σ x^m ≡ -1 iff (p-1)|m, m>0; absent cells contribute p-1 ≡ -1 each → uniform sign (-1)^K)

Produce final formula: Ans = A^p + (-1)^K · M (mod p), with M as above; verified by hand on Sample 1
Implement solve() with numpy float-split matmul for A^p mod p, p=2 special case, correction matrix M, fast I/O
Validate against brute force on random tiny cases (N≤3, p∈{2,3,5,7}) including K=0 and all-zero matrices; check all three samples — exhaustive and random tests all passed, samples match
